info.name: Productiv Developer App Details Audit Events API

params.name: startTime
params.description: Start time for the query range.

params.name: endTime
params.description: End time for the query range.

params.name: nextPageToken
params.description: Token for fetching the next page of results, obtained from a previous response.

items.docs: Fetch a stream of audit events for activities performed by users on the Productiv platform. Each request returns a maximum of 500 events. If more events exist in the queried time range, the response contains a nextPageToken for pagination.
